verification_gaps.summary: The no-HTTP replacement did not require an in-process MCP protocol exercise.
verification_gaps.evidence: The initial plan allowed a source assertion that could pass without proving runtime discovery or invocation.
verification_gaps.impact: Handler-only and SAM tests would leave the real MCP server boundary unverified.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Create the real server, list tools, and invoke the new tool through an in-process MCP client/server transport.

resolution: Accepted before implementation. The plan and acceptance contract now require no-network in-process tools/list and tools/call coverage.
